findings.reason: with no declared dependency on §4–§6 and §8, a build ordered by section number would run the proof at §7 before the chain it measures and before the §8 filter it reports removed candidates for, so the fragment would be produced from unbuilt machinery; the plan already records an intra-plan dependency for the same reason at §8 (`mapping-decision-chain#s5`).
findings.text: §7's node text requires the run to happen "once §4 to §6 and §8 have landed", yet §7's `plan-section-depends-on` lists only `signal-cocos-conventions#s8` and names none of this plan's §4, §5, §6 or §8, even though §8 is a later section than §7
